messages:
anita: Quick thread to capture infra follow-ups from today's all-hands — GPU + autoscale questions.

santiago: TL;DR: vendor confirmed initial A100 test racks arriving week of Jun 9; broader shipments through July. First targets: us-west-2, eu-west-1. APAC later.

raj: Will new racks immediately enter shared pools?

santiago: No — they come up as onboarding pools (label: onboarding-a100). After validation and firmware/kernel upgrades we tag them shared or dedicated per ops/sales requests.

maya: Autoscaler update: new per-pool 'burstable' flag + tenant_cap. Burstable pools can accept temporary extra load (1.5x default) for 90s; tenant_cap prevents single-tenant monopolies.

anita: Canary plan and monitoring?

maya: Canary: 48h in one AZ then 72h wider if stable. Monitoring: token p95, cold starts, queued jobs, and a small golden-prompt quality check. Eng-platform will publish the runbook tomorrow.

raj: Action items:
- maya: land tenant_cap default + docs (due 2025-05-15)
- eng-platform: publish canary runbook + dates (due 2025-05-12)
- ops: verify APAC customs ETA (due 2025-05-10)

infra-bot: [link] draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/a100-canary-draft

anita: I'll compile follow-ups and ping sales for Dedicated rack LOAs.

santiago: I'll open a 'rack-tracking' thread when we have vendor tracking numbers. Treat dates as tentative until then.
